text:
Subject: Document confirmation

Please confirm now. Your access will be terminated if the form is not returned.
rationale: Immediate confirmation and loss of access are explicitly communicated.

text:
Subject: Profile check

Human resources asks you to review the contact information shown in your staff profile.
rationale: An institutional role is presented as the source of the request.

text:
Subject: Membership benefit

Claim your reward by returning the membership form. Delivery arrangements will follow.
rationale: A benefit is offered as an inducement to engage; no short deadline is stated.

text:
Subject: Payment details check

The payroll team asks you to reply immediately with the requested details.
rationale: The request invokes an internal team and demands an immediate response.

text:
Subject: Mailbox restriction

Your mailbox has been blocked. Complete the identity form to restore access.
rationale: Loss of service access is communicated as a reason to complete a form.

text:
Subject: Travel draw result

You have been selected as a winner. Send your delivery address to arrange the package.
rationale: Special selection as a winner is communicated to induce a response.

text:
Subject: Form closing time

Return the signed form before midnight. The submission window closes tonight.
rationale: A same-day deadline creates time pressure.

text:
Subject: Employee benefit message

The CEO invites you to claim your bonus through the attached form.
rationale: A senior role and a benefit are used together to support engagement.

text:
Subject: Confirmation window

You have ten minutes left to finish this confirmation. Send your answer without delay.
rationale: A short time window conveys urgency even without a specific configured phrase.

text:
Subject: Approval request

Send the approval before lunch today; this cannot wait until the afternoon.
rationale: The message demands action within a short same-day period.

text:
Subject: Finance instruction

The Head of Finance has instructed you to complete the attached authorization form.
rationale: A senior organizational role is presented as backing the instruction.

text:
Subject: Student details request

The university registrar requires you to confirm the details shown on this form.
rationale: An institutional role is presented as the source of a requirement.

text:
Subject: Sign-in check

We will remove your ability to sign in unless you submit the form.
rationale: Loss of account access is threatened in different wording.

text:
Subject: Storage check

Your files will be erased unless you complete the check.
rationale: Loss of files is presented as a negative consequence of inaction.

text:
Subject: Voucher collection

A complimentary voucher is waiting for you. Submit your details to receive it.
rationale: An offered benefit is used to encourage disclosure or engagement.

text:
Subject: Travel package

You are the lucky recipient of a travel package. Send your address to arrange delivery.
rationale: Special selection and an offered travel benefit invite a response.

text:
Subject: Support appointment

The help desk has confirmed your appointment. You can review it in the usual staff portal.
rationale: The notice invokes an institutional support role, even in an ordinary scenario.

text:
Subject: Building access survey

The security team is updating the visitor process. Please submit comments by the end of the day.
rationale: An ordinary work notice contains both an institutional role and a same-day deadline.

text:
Subject: Mailbox retirement

As agreed in your service request, the old mailbox will be disabled. Keep using your replacement address.
rationale: The text describes loss of access; its agreed context does not remove that consequence cue.

text:
Subject: Library workshop

Participants receive a free gift at the workshop. Registration is available at the usual library desk.
rationale: A normal promotion still offers a benefit to encourage participation.

text:
Subject: Discussion notes

The discussion notes are in our shared folder. Please add comments when convenient.
rationale: No short deadline, authority role, adverse consequence or reward appeal is asserted.

text:
Subject: Display settings

The account settings page now supports a larger font. The help article explains how to change it.
rationale: Account and help vocabulary alone do not communicate any of the four target meanings.

text:
Subject: Proofreading question

The word prize appears in paragraph two of the draft. Could you check whether the spelling is correct?
rationale: The word prize is discussed as text; no benefit is offered to the reader.

text:
Subject: Invoice routing

Please use the replacement payment details for the next invoice. The document contains the new account number.
rationale: The request could warrant verification but asserts none of the four target cue meanings; no safety label is assigned.
